messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The support value of the node 'ana=NAM' is 2." -- cites: E5 (Figure 2): observation "The node 'ana=NAM' has a value of (2,1) in the figure."
2. "The node 'ana=NAM' has a support value of 2 for the class 0." -- cites: E1 (Section A): quote "X 1 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 1 ) = 0 X 2 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=T } , C ( X 2 ) = 1 X 3 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NOM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 3 ) = 0 • A = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F, head-match=T, ant-type=NOM } , • support ( a i , 0) a i ∈ A = { 2,1,2,0,1 } , e.g. “anatype=NAM” appeared two times in noncoreferring ( C ( X i ) = 0 ) samples, If we sort A based on a i ’s frequencies, i.e. support ( a i , 0) + support ( a i , 1) , the ordering of A ’s items will remain the same."

4. "The evidence does not provide the support value of the node 'ana=NAM' for the class 0." -- cites: E1 (Section A): quote "X 1 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 1 ) = 0 X 2 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=T } , C ( X 2 ) = 1 X 3 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NOM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 3 ) = 0 • A = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F, head-match=T, ant-type=NOM } , • support ( a i , 0) a i ∈ A = { 2,1,2,0,1 } , e.g. “anatype=NAM” appeared two times in noncoreferring ( C ( X i ) = 0 ) samples, If we sort A based on a i ’s frequencies, i.e. support ( a i , 0) + support ( a i , 1) , the ordering of A ’s items will remain the same."
